auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_015 IS NULL OR c.XCL_015 = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
WHERE c.XCL_004 = 'mythic'
  AND l.XCL_085 = 'commander'
  AND l.XCL_084 = 'legal'
  AND (c.XCL_011 IS NULL OR c.XCL_011 = '*')
